title: Delivery
conditions: Once per order within the city and up to 20 km; clarify access and floor beforehand.

title: Standard oven installation
conditions: Per appliance; suitable existing niche and connection required. No alterations.

title: Standard integrated dishwasher installation
conditions: Per appliance; suitable connections and matching front required. A new furniture front is excluded.

title: Freestanding dishwasher connection
conditions: Per appliance at suitable accessible connections.

title: Washing machine connection
conditions: Per appliance at suitable existing connections.

title: Old-appliance collection in the training package
conditions: Per appliance with delivery; clarify type and access beforehand. No statement on general statutory obligations.

title: On-site installation assessment
conditions: Commissioned separately; no automatic credit against purchase or installation.

title: Electric household appliance diagnosis
conditions: Supported electric household appliances only; repair, parts, replacement appliance and success guarantee excluded.

title: Repair
conditions: A separate quotation and consent are required; no fixed price recorded.
